sources.snippet: 🧃 parakeet-tdt-.6b-v3: Multilingual Speech-to-Text Model CoreML | | | | On‑device multilingual ASR model converted to Core ML for Apple platforms. This model powers FluidAudio's batch ASR and is the same model used in our backend. It supports 25 European languages and is optimized for low‑latency, private, offline transcription.

sources.snippet: This work introduces Canary-1B-v2, a multilingual, multi-task model designed to deliver robust ASR and AST performance with high efficiency. In addition, we release Parakeet-TDT-.6B-v3, a smaller yet more accurate ASR model supporting the same 25 languages.
